pictures.author: Carole Raddato
pictures.observations: Entire960x640 ordinary forecourt view inspected. Two battered first-pylon towers with cavetto cornices, central tall gate and smaller west-tower doorway, vertical flagstaff recesses and shallow relief. Long forecourt colonnades with varied flared plant capitals/architraves and open center.

pictures.author: Carole Raddato
pictures.observations: Entire960x636 ordinary second-pylon front inspected. Two sloping stone towers at a different alignment, cavetto tops, lower connecting gateway with real dark portal, tall vertical recesses, small square openings and large shallow upright figure/line compositions. Original simplified vocabulary rather than copied narrative/deity or hieroglyphic imagery.

pictures.author: Gilles Renault
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 ordinary court/portico view inspected to fill column-capital/passage coverage gap. Smooth stone shafts with banded tops and distinct open lotus/palm-like flaring capitals under flat architrave/roof, real door in rear wall, low broken screen blocks and open ground. Title does not establish exact individual bay identity; hidden bay assignment approximate.

pictures.author: Jorge Lascar
pictures.observations: Entire960x638 ordinary side exterior inspected to cover the sanctuary behind the pylons. Lower and taller flat-roof sandstone ranges, projecting cavetto cornice, shallow original relief/stone joint vocabulary, a real recessed side entrance and occupied narrow buried stone footing/short threshold. No complete hidden ritual interior inferred.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Isis complex on Agilkia: two differently aligned battered twin pylons/real central passages and smaller first-tower door, cavetto cornices/flagstaff slots, original simplified shallow figure/register vocabulary, mapped rear sanctuary with both open roof courts, west birth-house-like range and east court portico with flared plant-capital columns, plus both mapped long forecourt colonnades. Native open courts/forecourt retained. No island slab, copied deity/story/hieroglyph atlas, complete hidden ritual interior or neighboring Trajan kiosk/independent monuments.
